question: Who among the following has been named as the Chairman of the WHO Executive Board in May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harsh Vardhan**__.

__
 
• **Harsh Vardhan has been named the Chairman of the WHO Executive Board in May 2020**__.

 __
 
• Dr. Harsh Vardhan who was the then Minister of Health and Family Welfare was elected as the Chairman of the World Health Organization’s Executive Board.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Health Organisation:**

 
 
• It is a specialized agency of the United Nations that is responsible for **international public health.**
 
• It was formed in the year **1948**.
 
• Its **headquarters **are in **Geneva, Switzerland.**
